scope: Independent review of every one of 22 Cisco/HPE phase-one claim groups in verified-fixes-cisco-hpe.json. Official sources were reopened; this is a claim review, not certification of every possible configured system.
sourceMethod: Official HTML/PDF text and linked current revisions. DL380 PDF reached via Download link from the official viewer. Source locations are sufficient to reproduce each check.

claims.conclusion: Cisco C245 M8 Table14 pp33–34 names UCSC-GPU-MI210, three-card maximum, 300W/64GB, risers and accessories. UCS Manager 4.3(5c) release notes name the model. CPU-family pairing remains unscoped, appropriately.

X440p M8 Table4 p9 explicitly lists two MI210 cards on Gen4 risers1A/2A, excludes X210c; Step2 requires both risers and includes cables; Steps4/5 require 9416-D and supported mezzanine. UCS Manager 4.3(6a) identifies X215c support. X440p evidence is not transferred to X580p or all CPU pairings.
FAQ updated15Feb2024 explicitly dates original announcement6Feb2024. The later June portfolio event is not treated as first launch.
Current QuickSpecs Core Options lists P84312-B21 DLC and compatible hoses/rack solution. P76605-B21 internal closed loop is correctly distinguished from facility DLC.
Current QuickSpecs Core Options lists P80827-B21 facility DLC plus full rack/CDU/manifold/hoses. Closed-loop option uses inlet air and excludes GPU CTO.
Current QuickSpecs Core Options lists P84592-B21 DLC with matching hoses, six performance fans and rack-level infrastructure.
Current QuickSpecs Core Options lists P81123-B21 DLC, six performance fans and complete rack solution. Thermal/chassis specificity retained.
Current QuickSpecs Core Options lists P74208-B21 PCIe and P79273-B21 NS204 DLC options, hoses and infrastructure. Internal CLC remains distinct.
Air/DLC positive claims pass. Core Options also requires quantity2processors when DLC selected. Review found missing processor/cooling correlation; root reports applying Air[1,2], Liquid[2] variants.

V20 pp32–33 lists P74204-B21 and P74208-B21 with hoses, excludes mid tray; PCIe option requires secondary riser and consumes slot6. P16 independently requires CPU2 for secondary riser. NS204 DLC CPU population is not explicitly resolved. Root will expose only positively established2CPU+Liquid;1CPU+Liquid remains unestablished, not prohibited.
Air/DLC positive claims pass. DLC Solutions explicitly requires2processors. Review found missing processor/cooling correlation; root reports applying Air[1,2], Liquid[2] variants.
Current QuickSpecs Core Options lists P78016-B21 DLC and P62042-B21 tubes. No mixed heatsinks. Two cold plates per module do not independently establish all processor populations.
Current QuickSpecs Core Options lists P82520-B21 CPU DLC plus tube kit, consumes rearSlot1 and excludes10DW FIO/front drive fan combinations. Model-level choice remains conditional.
QuickSpecs Accelerator/Step2 sections show H200 Air or DLC; B200/B300/MI355X DLC. Accelerator-specific chassis and kits remain required.
Official HPE product listing What is New names air/DLC alternatives. Announced lifecycle and exact-build uncertainty preserved.

Launch QuickSpecs Step3 lists S6A73C and S6W21C, populations0/1/2/4/8, no mixing, P97059-B21 cable kit. Technical page says air-cooled; HPE launch blog gives March2027 planned availability. Options remain announced, and no AMD GPU claim is inferred.
QuickSpecs SFF/LFF minimum weight includes oneCPU; EDSFF minimum is twoCPU. The new note preserves this chassis distinction and local-resource restrictions.
V20 p18 OCP note describes1CPU and2CPU cases; pp16–18 map secondary/tertiary I/O to CPU2. One CPU positive model-level population is supported; cooling combinations require the separate caveat.
Current V14 Step3 explicitly permits1/2 matching CPUs, P68225-B21 front heatsink for1CPU and additional P68226-B21 rear for2CPU. Memory/technical sections support16slots per installedCPU and32max.
Current QuickSpecs technical minima and memory section document1/2CPU and16DIMMs per installedCPU,32max. Local-I/O caveat appropriate.
HPE technical launch blog names dualCPU per node,16channels/CPU andMRDIMM. Physicalslotcount andDPC remain unknown; no capacity geometry invented.
HPE technical launch blog names dualCPU per node,16channels/CPU andMRDIMM. Physicalslotcount andDPC remain unknown; chassis/node scope retained.

findings.conclusion: A model supporting1/2CPU and Air/Liquid independently must not automatically become a documented1CPU+Liquid configuration. Exact QuickSpecs require2CPU forDLC.
recommendedChecks: DL365/DL3851CPU+Liquid does not produce a documented match.
DL365/DL3852CPU+Liquid remains positive without asserting a GPU combination.

findings.conclusion: PCIe DLC requires secondary riser; secondary riser requiresCPU2. NS204 DLC count is not explicitly resolved;1CPU+Liquid is unestablished rather than globallyunsupported.
